news.titleEn: Nvidia earnings takeaways: Huang forecasts 70% fiscal 2028 revenue growth, far above estimates
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year, with adjusted EPS of $2.22, and guided Q3 revenue to about $108 billion, well ahead of Wall Street estimates.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达第二财季营收962亿美元同比翻倍，下季指引远超预期
news.whyEn: As the AI chip bellwether, Nvidia's blowout results and CEO Jensen Huang's forecast of roughly 70% revenue growth in fiscal 2028 eased fears that AI infrastructure spending is peaking, lifting global tech sentiment.
news.whyZh: 作为AI芯片风向标，业绩爆表加上黄仁勋对2028财年增长约70%的预测，缓解了市场对AI投资见顶的担忧。
news.detailEn: Nvidia's revenue beat the roughly $92 billion consensus, with data-center sales of $89 billion up 117% from a year ago and gross margin at 75%. The stock, which had fallen the day after earnings for four straight quarters on what analysts call an 'expectations premium,' rose about 4% in extended trading to around $219 after CFO Colette Kress signaled strong fiscal 2028 growth. Huang said demand for current Blackwell and next-generation Rubin systems is accelerating. The report landed the same day as a hotter-than-expected US inflation reading, making it a pivotal session for the AI trade.
news.detailZh: 英伟达营收超出约920亿美元的市场共识，数据中心业务营收890亿美元、同比增长117%，毛利率75%。此前该股连续四个季度在财报次日因分析师所称的「预期溢价」下跌，这次在首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯释放2028财年强劲增长信号后，盘后上涨约4%至约219美元。黄仁勋表示，现有Blackwell与下一代Rubin系统的需求正在加速。财报与当日公布的高于预期的美国通胀数据同天出炉，成为AI交易的关键一役。

news.titleEn: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over 'surging demand'
news.conclusionEn: Amazon Web Services and Nvidia announced that AWS will deploy 2 million additional Nvidia GPUs — Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra — across its data centers in 2027-2028, plus Nvidia's new Vera CPUs.
news.conclusionZh: 亚马逊AWS宣布2027至2028年再部署200万块英伟达GPU及Vera CPU
news.whyEn: Unveiled on Nvidia's earnings call five months after AWS committed to 1 million GPUs, the deal is fresh evidence that hyperscalers are still spending aggressively on AI despite investor worries about a slowdown.
news.whyZh: 在AWS此前承诺采购100万块GPU仅五个月后再度加码，显示大型云厂商仍在激进投入AI算力。
news.detailEn: AWS said the additional GPUs will power AI factories for agentic and physical AI, and the two companies will also build secure data centers for the US government with 100,000 GPUs. Nvidia CFO Colette Kress said Amazon could buy 'millions' of Vera CPUs, some integrated with Rubin and some standalone. AWS will also offer Nvidia's Nemotron open models through Bedrock and SageMaker and adopt Nvidia's robotics software stack for warehouse automation. The announcement helped push Nvidia shares higher after hours and lifted Nasdaq futures.
news.detailZh: AWS表示，新增GPU将用于支撑面向智能体和具身智能的「AI工厂」，双方还将为美国政府建设配备10万块GPU的安全数据中心。英伟达首席财务官克雷斯称，亚马逊可能采购「数百万颗」Vera CPU，部分与Rubin集成、部分独立部署。AWS还将通过Bedrock和SageMaker提供英伟达Nemotron开源模型，并在仓储自动化中采用英伟达的机器人软件栈。该消息助推英伟达盘后股价上涨，并带动纳斯达克期货走高。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 closes little changed as investors weigh sticky inflation and await Nvidia earnings
news.conclusionEn: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge showed headline PCE rising 3.7% year over year in July, above the 3.6% expected, while core PCE held at 3.3%; US stocks ended Wednesday mixed with the S&P 500 near 7,676.
news.conclusionZh: 美国7月PCE通胀同比3.7%高于预期，美股周三涨跌互现
news.whyEn: Inflation stuck well above the Fed's 2% target complicates the rate outlook two days before Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote, with markets still pricing meaningful odds of a September rate hike rather than a cut.
news.whyZh: 通胀远高于美联储2%目标，令9月议息前景更趋复杂，市场仍押注可能加息。
news.detailEn: Headline PCE rose 0.2% on the month versus a 0.1% forecast, while core PCE matched expectations at 0.2% monthly and 3.3% annually. Treasury yields initially dipped on the data then edged up as traders focused on the hotter headline figure. The S&P 500 finished roughly flat around 7,676, the Nasdaq was little changed, and investors held back ahead of Nvidia's after-the-close report. The reading is the last major inflation data before the September 16 FOMC meeting.
news.detailZh: 整体PCE环比上涨0.2%，高于0.1%的预期；核心PCE环比0.2%、同比3.3%，均符合预期。美债收益率在数据公布后先跌后微升，交易员更关注偏高的整体通胀数字。标普500指数收盘基本持平于约7676点，纳斯达克变化不大，投资者在英伟达盘后财报前保持观望。这是9月16日美联储议息会议前最后一份重要通胀数据。

news.titleEn: Warsh to Make First Jackson Hole Speech as Fed Chair
news.conclusionEn: The Kansas City Fed's Jackson Hole symposium opens Thursday, with Kevin Warsh due to deliver his first keynote as Fed chair on Friday, August 28, amid debate over whether the Fed's next move is a cut or a hike.
news.conclusionZh: 杰克逊霍尔年会周四开幕，沃什周五将首次以美联储主席身份发表演讲
news.whyEn: With inflation running around 3.4-3.7% and the labor market softening, Warsh's roughly 20-minute address — 19 days before the September FOMC decision — could tip market expectations for the policy path.
news.whyZh: 通胀居高、就业转弱，这场演讲距9月议息仅19天，或成左右市场预期的关键。
news.detailEn: This year's symposium is themed 'Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy,' drawing about 120 central bankers and economists from more than 70 countries. Warsh has kept the fed funds rate at 3.50-3.75% at both meetings since succeeding Jerome Powell, and long-term Treasury yields have climbed on doubts about his inflation resolve. Markets are pricing roughly one-in-three odds of a September rate hike. Investors will parse whether Warsh emphasizes still-elevated inflation, signalling higher-for-longer, or labor-market weakness, signalling cuts.
news.detailZh: 本届年会主题为「金融创新：对支付与政策的影响」，吸引来自70多个国家的约120名央行官员和经济学家参会。自接替鲍威尔以来，沃什已在两次会议上将联邦基金利率维持在3.50%至3.75%，市场对其抗通胀决心的疑虑推高了长期美债收益率。目前市场定价9月加息概率约三分之一。投资者将关注沃什是强调仍然偏高的通胀（意味着高利率维持更久），还是强调就业疲软（意味着降息）。

news.titleEn: U.S. crude hovers around $80 as oil prices sink on Hormuz deal hopes
news.conclusionEn: Oil fell for a third straight session Wednesday, with US WTI down about 2.2% to $80.52 and Brent off 2.5% to $86.38, after reports that Iran and Oman discussed a temporary joint shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 油价连跌三日，WTI跌至80.52美元，因霍尔木兹海峡通航谈判现进展
news.whyEn: Signs of de-escalation and US sanctions on Iran that proved milder than feared are draining the geopolitical risk premium from crude, easing a source of upward pressure on global inflation and bond yields.
news.whyZh: 局势缓和加上对伊制裁力度弱于预期，地缘风险溢价消退，缓解全球通胀与债市压力。
news.detailEn: The Trump administration has signaled a shift from military strikes toward economic pressure on Tehran, and traders are betting shipping through Hormuz — a chokepoint for roughly a fifth of global oil — could gradually normalize. Pakistan also reported progress in de-escalation talks. Lower crude prices helped Treasury yields retreat from multi-decade highs. Analysts caution the situation remains fragile and prices could snap back if talks collapse or attacks resume.
news.detailZh: 特朗普政府已释放信号，将对伊朗的施压重点从军事打击转向经济手段，交易员押注约占全球五分之一石油运输的霍尔木兹海峡通航有望逐步恢复正常。巴基斯坦也表示缓和谈判取得进展。油价走低帮助美债收益率从数十年高位回落。分析师提醒局势仍脆弱，若谈判破裂或袭击重启，油价可能迅速反弹。

news.titleEn: At least 157 killed and hundreds missing after flash floods in Nepal and China
news.conclusionEn: Flash floods along the Nepal-China border killed at least 157 people and left more than 400 missing — most of them foreign nationals — after a landslide and glacier collapse sent a wall of water down the Bhote Koshi river.
news.conclusionZh: 尼泊尔与中国边境山洪已致至少157人遇难，逾400人失踪
news.whyEn: With 341 foreign nationals among the missing and about 430 megawatts of Nepal's power capacity damaged, the disaster is one of the deadliest in the region in years and highlights rising climate risks to Himalayan infrastructure.
news.whyZh: 逾340名外国公民失踪，约430兆瓦发电能力受损，为该地区近年最严重灾害之一。
news.detailEn: Nepali officials said 403 people were reported missing, including pilgrims returning from Mount Kailash in Tibet; the missing include nationals of India, the US, Australia, the UK and Canada. A landslide in China blocked the Bhote Koshi river before a glacier broke, unleashing a fast-moving mix of ice, rock and monsoon-soaked sediment that destroyed roads, bridges and buildings on both sides of the border. The Nepal Electricity Authority said hydropower and solar facilities lost roughly 430 MW of capacity. Rescue operations were hampered by damaged access routes and continuing monsoon rains.
news.detailZh: 尼泊尔官员表示，共有403人被报失踪，其中包括从西藏冈仁波齐朝圣返回的信众；失踪者涉及印度、美国、澳大利亚、英国和加拿大等国公民。中国一侧发生山体滑坡阻断博特科西河，随后冰川崩塌，裹挟冰块、岩石和被季风雨浸透的泥沙形成快速下泄的洪流，冲毁边境两侧的道路、桥梁和建筑。尼泊尔电力局称，水电和太阳能设施损失约430兆瓦发电能力。道路损毁和持续的季风降雨使救援工作受阻。

news.titleEn: Ukrainian air attacks kill three in Russia as Kyiv steps up drone campaign
news.conclusionEn: Ukrainian drones struck the Lukoil-owned NORSI refinery in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region overnight, halting operations at the country's fourth-largest refinery, as President Zelenskyy said Ukraine hit 16 targets in Russia over the past day.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰无人机夜袭俄罗斯第四大炼油厂，致其停产
news.whyEn: NORSI accounts for up to 11% of Russia's gasoline output, and the sustained strike campaign on refineries is squeezing Russian fuel supplies and export revenue while Moscow presses its own attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
news.whyZh: 该厂占俄汽油产量最高11%，持续打击正挤压俄燃料供应与出口收入。
news.detailEn: Ukraine's General Staff said the overnight attack sparked a large fire and damaged processing units at the Kstovo plant, which processes about 15-17 million tonnes of crude a year; industry sources said repairs could take time. It was at least the fifth Ukrainian strike on the refinery in 2026. Russian attacks the same day damaged the Kherson heat-and-power plant and hit Sloviansk, and Russian drones killed three people and destroyed a Wildberries warehouse. Diesel prices in Russia have climbed toward record highs amid the refinery outages.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰总参谋部称，夜间袭击在克斯托沃炼油厂引发大火并损坏加工装置，该厂年加工原油约1500万至1700万吨，业内人士称修复需要时间。这是2026年乌克兰至少第五次打击该厂。俄罗斯同日的攻击损坏了赫尔松热电厂并袭击斯拉维扬斯克，俄无人机造成3人遇难并摧毁一座Wildberries仓库。在炼厂停产之下，俄罗斯柴油价格已升向历史高位。

news.titleEn: CrowdStrike Lifts Annual Revenue Forecast on Rising AI Cybersecurity Threats
news.conclusionEn: CrowdStrike raised its full-year revenue outlook to about $6 billion after beating estimates with quarterly revenue of $1.47 billion, while Salesforce and Okta also topped forecasts, sending all three stocks higher after hours.
news.conclusionZh: CrowdStrike上调全年营收指引，与Salesforce、Okta财报齐超预期
news.whyEn: Strong results across enterprise software and cybersecurity suggest corporate AI adoption is driving real revenue growth, reinforcing the sector's rally alongside Nvidia's earnings.
news.whyZh: 企业软件与网络安全业绩强劲，显示AI落地正带来实际营收增长，强化板块涨势。
news.detailEn: CrowdStrike reported adjusted EPS of $0.31 versus $0.29 expected, revenue up about 26%, and net new annual recurring revenue of $256 million, and lifted its ARR guidance. Salesforce jumped by double digits in extended trading after raising revenue guidance, and Okta also beat. Executives cited demand for AI-driven security tools as attackers increasingly use AI. The reports came the same evening as Nvidia's, capping a heavy day for tech earnings.
news.detailZh: CrowdStrike调整后每股收益0.31美元，高于预期的0.29美元，营收同比增长约26%，新增年度经常性收入2.56亿美元，并上调了ARR指引。Salesforce在上调营收指引后盘后大涨两位数，Okta业绩也超预期。高管表示，随着攻击者越来越多地使用AI，市场对AI驱动的安全工具需求旺盛。这些财报与英伟达同晚公布，为科技股财报密集日画上句号。

news.titleEn: Stock Market Today: Dow, S&P Live Updates for August 27
news.conclusionEn: US equity futures and the dollar firmed early Thursday after Nvidia's upbeat outlook, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 contracts up around 1%, while Asian markets were mixed.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达乐观指引提振美股期货，周四亚洲股市涨跌不一
news.whyEn: Nvidia's guidance snapped its seven-day pre-earnings losing streak and reassured investors that the AI capex cycle has room to run, steadying sentiment after a jittery August.
news.whyZh: 英伟达指引结束财报前七连跌，重振市场对AI资本开支周期的信心。
news.detailEn: Nasdaq 100 futures rose about 1% and S&P 500 futures gained after CFO Colette Kress guided to strong fiscal 2028 growth. Asian equity futures pointed to gains in South Korea and losses in Japan and Australia. Gold held near a three-month high, having risen more than 15% in August, and Treasury yields were slightly lower on the month as investors awaited Friday's Jackson Hole keynote. Oil steadied after three days of declines.
news.detailZh: 在首席财务官克雷斯给出2028财年强劲增长指引后，纳斯达克100期货上涨约1%，标普500期货走高。亚洲股指期货显示韩国上涨、日本和澳大利亚下跌。金价维持在三个月高位附近，8月累计涨幅超15%，美债收益率当月小幅走低，投资者等待周五的杰克逊霍尔主题演讲。油价在连续三日下跌后企稳。

news.titleEn: Gold hovers near three-month high on dollar weakness, Treasury bond buyback plans
news.conclusionEn: Gold traded near its highest level since mid-May, around $4,650 an ounce, and is up more than 15% in August as a weaker dollar and US Treasury buyback plans support the metal.
news.conclusionZh: 金价逼近三个月高位，约每盎司4650美元，8月累计上涨超15%
news.whyEn: The surge reflects investor demand for safe havens amid sticky inflation, doubts over Fed independence and elevated geopolitical risk, and rising gold prices often signal broader unease about currencies and policy.
news.whyZh: 通胀顽固、美联储独立性存疑、地缘风险高企，共同推动避险需求升温。
news.detailEn: Spot gold was little changed around $4,647 an ounce, near a three-month peak, while gold futures hovered near $4,694. The dollar index has fallen about 0.8% in August, making gold cheaper for foreign buyers, and a US plan to buy back Treasury bonds has helped cap yields. Bullion has been one of 2026's strongest trades, buoyed by central-bank buying and inflows into gold-backed funds. Traders are watching Friday's Jackson Hole speech for the next catalyst.
news.detailZh: 现货黄金基本持平于每盎司约4647美元，接近三个月高点，黄金期货在4694美元附近徘徊。美元指数8月下跌约0.8%，令黄金对海外买家更便宜，美国回购国债的计划也有助于压低收益率。在央行购金和黄金ETF资金流入的推动下，黄金是2026年表现最强的资产之一。交易员正关注周五的杰克逊霍尔演讲以寻找下一个催化剂。

businessTips.explanationEn: Unit economics is the direct revenue and costs tied to a single unit of your business — one customer, one subscription, one order or one product sold. The two core measures are how much profit that unit generates over its lifetime (often called lifetime value, or LTV) and how much it costs to acquire it (customer acquisition cost, or CAC). If a business can't make a single unit profitable, growing faster usually just loses money faster. Analyzing unit economics tells you whether a business model actually works before you scale it.
businessTips.explanationZh: 单位经济效益指的是企业每一个「单位」——一位客户、一份订阅、一笔订单或售出的一件产品——所对应的直接收入与成本。两个核心指标是：这个单位在其生命周期内能带来多少利润（通常称为客户终身价值，LTV），以及获取这个单位需要花多少钱（客户获取成本，CAC）。如果一家企业连单个单位都无法盈利，扩张往往只会让亏损更快扩大。分析单位经济效益能在你大规模扩张之前，判断这个商业模式是否真正成立。
businessTips.exampleEn: A subscription app earns $180 from the average customer over their lifetime but spends $250 on ads and sales to sign each one up. The unit economics are negative, so raising the marketing budget would only deepen losses; the fix is to lower acquisition cost or raise retention and price before spending more to grow.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一款订阅制App平均每位客户在生命周期内带来180美元收入，但为获取每位客户在广告和销售上要花250美元。单位经济效益为负，此时加大营销预算只会加剧亏损；正确做法是先降低获客成本，或提升留存率和定价，再投入资金扩张。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service packages freelance or consulting work into a fixed, clearly defined offer with a set scope, set price and a repeatable process — sold more like a product than a custom project. Instead of quoting every client differently, you sell something like 'a logo design for $500, delivered in 5 days' or 'unlimited design requests for $2,000 a month.' This makes a side business easier to market, faster to deliver and possible to scale or partly automate, because you solve the same problem the same way each time.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「产品化服务」是把自由职业或咨询类工作打包成一个固定、界定清晰的方案：范围固定、价格固定、流程可复制——像卖产品一样去卖，而不是每次都做定制项目。你不再对每位客户单独报价，而是卖诸如「500美元设计一个logo，5天交付」或「每月2000美元，设计需求不限量」这样的方案。这让副业更容易推广、交付更快，也更有可能规模化或部分自动化，因为你每次都在用同样的方式解决同样的问题。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelance writer who used to bid on varied projects instead offers one package: four SEO blog posts a month for a flat $1,200, with a standard intake form and editing checklist. Clients know exactly what they get, the writer can predict workload and income, and they can eventually hire a subcontractor to help fulfill without redesigning the offer each time.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位过去四处竞标各类项目的自由撰稿人，改为只提供一个套餐：每月4篇SEO博客文章，统一收费1200美元，配一份标准需求表和编辑清单。客户清楚知道自己能得到什么，撰稿人能预估工作量和收入，日后还能雇一位外包写手协助交付，而无需每次重新设计方案。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging is investing a fixed amount of money at regular intervals — say, $500 on the first of every month — regardless of whether the market is up or down. Because the fixed sum buys more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high, it smooths out your average purchase price over time and removes the pressure to 'time' the market. Its main value is behavioral: it turns investing into an automatic habit and reduces the risk of putting all your money in right before a downturn.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（平均成本法）是指每隔固定时间投入固定金额——比如每月1号投500美元——无论市场是涨是跌都照常执行。由于固定金额在价格低时能买到更多份额、价格高时买到更少份额，长期下来会平滑你的平均买入成本，也省去了「择时」的压力。它最大的价值在于行为层面：把投资变成自动化的习惯，降低了在市场大跌前一次性把钱全部投进去的风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: An investor puts $600 into a broad index fund every month for three years instead of trying to guess the bottom. In months when the fund drops, the $600 buys more units; in months it rises, it buys fewer. They end up with a reasonable average cost and a large position built without ever having to make a nerve-wracking lump-sum decision.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位投资者连续三年每月向一只宽基指数基金投入600美元，而不是试图猜测市场底部。基金下跌的月份，600美元能买到更多份额；上涨的月份则买得更少。三年下来，他获得了一个合理的平均成本，并在从未做过令人紧张的一次性大额决策的情况下，积累了可观的持仓。
